column2:
Payment Method : FPX (B2B)
Bank : Maybank, CIMB Bank
Payment Status : Success
column3:
1. Open eAuto Login page and click "Apply eAuto". Complete Captcha verification
2. Fill in the Pre-Application form (Sdn Bhd / Bhd) and click next
3. Tick the Declaration statement box
column4:
1. Select FPX (B2B)
2. Select Bank (Maybank)
3. Click "Submit and Pay"
4. Log in the payment sandbox
5. Complete TAC and choose Payment Status = Success
6. Complete payment
7. At the payment details page, download invoice and e-invoice
column5:
1. After click "Submit and Pay", the Fiuu sandbox will open the Maybank sandbox portal
2. After completing payment, system will display the confirmation page "Pre-Application Submitted for Review"
3. Ensure the details of the Invoice and e-Invoice is correct
4. Ensure in Pre-Application listing, it is Status = Approved
column6:
1. BO - Open Application Listing and view Pre-Application tab
2. BO - Copy the Application Link and open in a new tab
3. UCD - Fill in the application details until complete
4. BO (mfared) - Set UCD group to Authorized Dealer and click "Submit For Approval"
5. BO (jasons) - Click the Approve button in the BO Application form
6. UCD - Refresh the Application Link and upload the documents in Page 4
7. BO (mfared) - Open the Application Details > Registration Documents tab > Click Verified
8. UCD - Refresh the Application Link and Ensure system redirects to Application Page 5
